description: Withdraw a draft or sent quote the customer has not signed, with an optional reason. Signing links stop working and follow-ups stop. A withdrawn quote cannot be reopened; create a new quote if needed.

reason.description: Why it was withdrawn, up to 500 characters. Kept with the quote, not shown to the customer.

name: quotes_withdraw

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
